content: Yesu ye dongesiwacni fangkewec
Sabat dameng motome Sonda ubiyacte mac sae-saele Maria Magadalen ailu Maria agoine, yeke dongesi nganinogale hikeiboc.
Hei, Sugucnele angelo monicti honocmengkacni wame memeya sugucne tapiliineholec bawec. Bame yedi dongesile posa-nu yogo igockelu kpalundungkeme hikeme feina felu ngiyewec.
Ailu ye haicine ngani-nganiine latac-latac, nga ngakpiine kwalacne kaguwa ingucne.
Aime dongesi damong yenge ye nganilu hangocebame dengdeng kwelu homanogale ailu faibong.
Aime ngigac yeke hikeboc angelodi yanguc edocepawec, “Ngeke mi hangocngepana, ngeke Yesu malicpongka weibong, ye nganinogale kwesigabiyec, yogo na ngagegabac.
Aime yebac yawa mi fagac. Ye yowa edocngebawec, yogo hocne balaibelu gboliyelu fangkegac. Ngeke ya welelu mapicine nganinic.

Ngagegaic, ngeke yogo nganilu biyac hikelu mic-tengtengfocine yanguc edocebanic, ‘Yesu ye homackacni biyac gboliyelu fangkegac. Ye molickengelelu Galili prowinswa hikegac, ngenge iwa hikelu bafuwadaingte.’ Yowa yogo yakumac hocne edocngepabe ngagegabiyec.”
Inguc aime yeke hangocepame dongesi hegilelu belic-belicka mic-tengtengfocine siduc edocebanogale biyac gasackelu hikeiboc.
Gasacke hikelu yefewa Yesu bafuwaboc yedi yanguc miwec,
Inguc mime yeke emeina lelu ngosockelu higeina balu afeeiboc.
Aime Yesudi yanguc edocepawec,

content.text: “Ngeke mi hangocngepana. Ngeke hikelu ngic hae-gbafocne
Galili prowinswa hikeningte edocebaboc, yenge iwa hikelu nganicnudaingte.”

content: Hudu-baba ngic yengele siduc
Aime ngigac yeke hikeebocka hudu-baba ngic gocne yenge dongesi damongkeibong, yengelacni gocnedi taonka felu wiyac fikewec, yogolec siduc depec-baba ngic micne edocebayackeibong.

Edocebabong yenge Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele damongfocngineng yengeholec mingagec ailu yowa hefeibong. Ailu yowa mipangkelu hudu-baba ngic dongesi damongkeibong, yengi yowa miningte moneng yogolecsoc yelelu
yanguc miibong, “Ngenge yowa yanguc milu edocebadaing. ‘Nonge debocka gung faebengka yeicne mic-tengtengfocine yengi kwesilu kponggbongine hise balu hikegaing,’ ngenge inguc midaing.
Aime gawana ye yowa yogo ngagelu wiyac monic mi aingeledaicte. Ilec ngenge mi hangocngebadaic. Nongi yeholec yowa nalic mingagec aidabelengte.”
Inguc milu edocebabong hudu-baba ngic yenge moneng yogo balu yowa edocebaibong, yogo mibong sugulewec. Aime kwesac-yowangineng yogodi Yuda ngic-ngigac yengela sawelu fawecti yakumac fagachac.
Mic-tengteng bole badaing
Aime Yesu ye biyachac gbolicne gawecka mic-tengteng 11 yenge Galili prowinswa kupic monic iwa hikeningte edocebawec, iwa feibong.
Felu yeicne nganilu mitengkelu afeeibong. Aime ngic moniyang moniyangti sugu kwelenginengti mi ngagepangkeibong.
Aime Yesudi haicnginang welelu yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngagegaing, himong nga honocmengte bole-yowa tapiliineholec sasawa na biyachac neleyackewec.
Ilec ngenge hikelu ngic-ngigac himongne himongne sasawa bacebabong nale mic-tengtengfocne aidaing. Ailu ngenge Mamac nga Madec ailu Tili Asule wacka misa lowayeledabiyeng.

Aime nani ung-yowa sasawa edocngebalu gaiba, ngenge yowa yogo sasawa balaibeyackeningte edocebalu weduyeledabiyeng. Ailu ngagegaing, na hadengsoc hadengsoc ngengeholec gabe himongte dameng motodaicte.”

footnotes.text: Ngic yogo yenge Yesule mic-tengteng. Yesudi ngic hae-gba wacebawecte golowacfocine aigaing.
